seed_method: BIO-01 fixed synthetic/three real child streams; extra real streams SeedSequence(1573,spawn_key=(3003,...))
flow_stop: Finish when both 20000 proposals and 10 seconds are reached; otherwise stop at 60 seconds, preserve reached checkpoints.
time_contract: Checkpoint after first completed proposal at or beyond target, include draw/gate/member accumulator and previous checkpoint processing. Record actual time/count; shared conditional flow computes weighted and accepted jointly. Uniform/conditional order alternates by replicate on one worker/core. Cold process+input+sampler prep separately, plus actual wall since spawn, which includes preceding flows/replicates.
deterministic_shortcut: If G impossible or no Neff ties, report exact structural state with zero actual proposals and explicit shortcut status for each requested checkpoint; conditional members are NA if G impossible.
member_domain: All raw possible members, fixed before sampling; zero uniform gate hits means member estimate and RMSE NA, never zero.

time_to_error.rule: First observed qualifying checkpoint, no interpolation. Unqualified reference, undefined estimate or unreached target remains NA.

reference.exact: Independent finite hypergeometric analysis for impossible/certain/one possible event; verified on sealed small-N truth.
reference.count_quantile: For multi-gate reference, empirical 2.5/50/97.5% count quantile 95% order-statistic interval width <= max(1,5% of independent raw count range), assessed separately from member and gate qualification.
reference.failure: Retain incomplete/precision-failed status; no member RMSE or gate absolute error against an unqualified reference.
reference.independence: Independent seed does not eliminate shared sampler implementation error; N8 calibration retained.

exclusions: No P2 beta or nuclear programme
planned_status: Not yet run; each reference and each replicate/flow has an independent completion record
portability_note: Existing first replicate seeds and original synthetic input; reduced checks only.
